activity_statements.statement: provides cloud-based payroll processing and human capital management software to businesses globally
administers HR, talent management, time-and-attendance tracking, tax filing, and benefits enrollment for employer clients
provides business process outsourcing for payroll and HR functions, allowing employers to offload administrative operations
delivers compliance expertise and analytics to help employers manage regulatory requirements across jurisdictions
maintains a proprietary workforce data asset from over 75 years of payroll records, enabling benchmarking and economic analytics

name_reality_gap: ADP (Automatic Data Processing) sounds like a generic computing company but is a dominant payroll and HR software/outsourcing firm. The company handles compliance, tax filing, and regulatory work at scale that most people associate with accountants or government agencies — not a tech firm.
